display.purpose: The HIXFIELD wordmark-as-hero on the landing; Archivo's wdth axis at 125% is what makes it loud.

headline.purpose: Landing section headings; 1.875rem stepping to 2.25rem at the sm breakpoint.

title.purpose: Studio page titles; 1.5rem stepping to 1.875rem at sm.

body.purpose: Panel copy in ink-300; prose over media scrims in ink-100.

label.purpose: Form-field labels, help, and error lines at 13px.

data.purpose: Machine truth only: timecodes, seeds, credits, job ids, statuses, commands. Tabular figures enforced globally.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Emissive halo under lime primary buttons; the accent glows, surfaces do not cast.

shadows.name: console-drop
shadows.purpose: The landing terminal block floating on the page-scale lime section — the one dark-on-bright surface.

shadows.name: thumb-shadow
shadows.purpose: Grounds the 5x18px playhead thumb on its 3px track.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: hx-rise 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; staggers rise-1..rise-5 at 60ms steps
motion.purpose: The one authored entrance per page: content rises 14px into place.

motion.name: lamp
motion.purpose: Recording-lamp pulse on status dots for jobs in flight and unresolved setup.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal Lime action with an emissive glow and a 1px press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-lime-400, #ccff00); color: var(--color-ink-950, #09090b); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(204,255,0,0.15); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-lime-300, #dbff4d); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lime-400, #ccff00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button (Off)
components.description: The Explicit-Off Rule: a disabled primary re-renders as off, never as dimmed lime.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-off { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink-700, #26262e); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-ink-800, #17171d); color: var(--color-ink-400, #71717e); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Raised-ink action with a hairline that brightens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink-700, #26262e); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-ink-800, #17171d); color: var(--color-ink-50, #f5f5f7); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink-600, #34343e); background: rgba(38,38,46,0.6); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lime-400, #ccff00); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Panel-ink field; focus shifts the hairline toward lime, caret is lime.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink-700, #26262e); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-ink-900, #0e0e11); color: var(--color-ink-50, #f5f5f7); font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; caret-color: var(--color-lime-400, #ccff00); transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-400, #71717e); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink-600, #34343e); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(204,255,0,0.7); outline: none; }

components.name: Playhead Slider
components.description: Strength control styled as a timeline playhead: worn-lime fill, rectangular lime thumb, mono readout.
components.html: Strength0.80
components.css: .ds-slider-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-width: 260px; } .ds-slider-label { font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-ink-300, #9c9ca8); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-slider-value { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-ink-300, #9c9ca8); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; width: 40px; text-align: right; } .ds-hx-range { appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; flex: 1; height: 20px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-hx-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--range-track, var(--color-ink-700, #26262e)); } .ds-hx-range::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 5px; height: 18px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-lime-400, #ccff00); margin-top: -7.5px; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .ds-hx-range::-moz-range-track { height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--range-track, var(--color-ink-700, #26262e)); } .ds-hx-range::-moz-range-thumb { width: 5px; height: 18px; border: none; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-lime-400, #ccff00); box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); }

components.name: Switch
components.description: Lime track with an ink knob when on; hairline-ink track when off.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; } .ds-switch-track { position: relative; width: 36px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-ink-700, #26262e); transition: background-color 0.15s; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-switch-track.ds-on { background: var(--color-lime-400, #ccff00); } .ds-switch-knob { position: absolute; left: 2px; top: 2px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-ink-950, #09090b); transform: translateX(16px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-switch-label { font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-ink-300, #9c9ca8); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Exclusive picker; only the lime treatment reads as selected — hover stops short of white.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink-700, #26262e); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-ink-900, #0e0e11); } .ds-seg-opt { border: none; background: transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-ink-300, #9c9ca8); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-seg-opt:hover { background: var(--color-ink-800, #17171d); color: var(--color-ink-100, #e9e9ec); } .ds-seg-opt.ds-seg-active { background: var(--color-ink-700, #26262e); color: var(--color-lime-400, #ccff00); font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Mono pill reporting job state; the dot runs the recording-lamp pulse while rendering.
components.css: @keyframes ds-hx-lamp { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } } .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,194,77,0.3); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,194,77,0.1); color: var(--color-amber, #ffc24d); font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.025em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-amber, #ffc24d); animation: ds-hx-lamp 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }

components.name: Preset Card (selected)
components.description: The signature component: a camera preset as a looping video tile. Selected state = lime ring + mono selection tag; caption on a gradient scrim.
components.css: .ds-preset-card { position: relative; display: block; width: 240px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink-700, #26262e); background: var(--color-ink-900, #0e0e11); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-preset-card:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink-600, #34343e); } .ds-preset-card.ds-selected { border-color: var(--color-lime-400, #ccff00); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-lime-400, #ccff00); } .ds-preset-media { display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: var(--color-ink-850, #121216); color: var(--color-ink-600, #34343e); } .ds-preset-tag { position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 8px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-lime-400, #ccff00); color: var(--color-ink-950, #09090b); font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-preset-caption { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 32px 12px 10px; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(9,9,11,0.95), rgba(9,9,11,0.6) 50%, transparent); } .ds-preset-name { font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink-50, #f5f5f7); } .ds-preset-desc { font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-ink-300, #9c9ca8); }

narrative.overview: Hixfield is a color-grading room after hours: layered near-blacks under hairline borders, one lime signal, and a gallery of looping camera-motion previews doing the talking. The preset gallery IS the interface — the product's beauty is the catalog itself, so chrome recedes into flat ink panels and the generated media carries the visual weight. The system explicitly refuses the SaaS-dashboard arrangement: no stat cards, no hero metrics, no decorative gradients. Two voices speak. Archivo (a variable face with its width axis loaded) is the human voice — the wide-set HIXFIELD wordmark, headlines, prose, labels. Spline Sans Mono is the machine voice, reserved strictly for data: timecodes, elapsed seconds, seeds, credit costs, job ids, status labels, shell commands. Depth comes from ink layering, not shadows; life comes from the media (hover-play video tiles, a recording-lamp pulse on jobs in flight), not from ornament. There is exactly one theme. The root declares color-scheme: dark and no light palette exists anywhere in the build — this is a deliberate commitment to a single dark look, not an omission. Do not add a light mode.
keyCharacteristics: Layered near-black surfaces (#09090b → #17171d) separated by 1px hairlines, never by shadows
One accent — lime #ccff00 — used as state in the studio, committed at page scale only once, on the landing
Two faces with a hard boundary: Archivo for language, Spline Sans Mono for data
Motion grammar of exactly two devices: the staggered rise entrance and the recording-lamp pulse
Media-first: preset cards are looping video tiles; text sits on gradient scrims over the footage

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime is the only accent, and in the studio it only ever means state: selection, activity, the primary action, focus. It never decorates. Page-scale lime belongs to the Persuade surface (the landing's "Run it tonight" block) alone; no Operate surface floods it.

rules.name: The Tinted-Status Rule
rules.body: Status colors render as a 10% fill + 30% border + full-strength text and dot (text-amber border-amber/30 bg-amber/10), never as solid chips.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Spline Sans Mono is strictly for machine truth: timecodes and elapsed seconds, seeds, credit costs, job ids, status-badge labels, endpoint paths, selection tags (A/B), env vars and shell commands, provenance captions. It never sets a heading, a sentence of prose, or a button label.

rules.name: The Width-Axis Rule
rules.body: Archivo's wdth axis is the expressive range. The wordmark sets at font-stretch: 125% everywhere it appears (hero, nav, footer, sidebar); one landing headline uses 115%. Expression comes from width at these marquee moments — not from new faces, italics, or ultra weights.

rules.name: The One-Entrance Rule
rules.body: Each page gets exactly one authored entrance: the header block and its siblings ride animate-rise (0.65s, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), 14px rise) with rise-1…rise-5 staggers at 60ms steps. Nothing else animates on load, and prefers-reduced-motion collapses all animation globally.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows on the dark ground. Separation is a 1px ink-700 border plus a tonal step; the signal glow, the console drop, and the thumb shadow are the entire shadow vocabulary.

rules.name: The Recording-Lamp Rule
rules.body: Work in flight pulses like a tally lamp: animate-lamp (1.6s ease-in-out, opacity 1 → 0.35 → 1) on a 6px status dot — rendering jobs, the missing-key chip, characters in training. Inline waits use the small stroke spinner instead; the lamp is reserved for live jobs and unresolved setup.

rules.name: The Explicit-Off Rule
rules.body: A disabled primary is never a dimmed lime button: it re-renders as explicitly off — ink-800 fill, ink-700 border, ink-400 semibold text. Only non-primary variants use 50% opacity when disabled.

rules.name: The Lime-Ring Selection Rule
rules.body: Selected = border-lime-400 plus a 1px lime ring, plus a 24px lime square at the top-right carrying the selection tag in mono ("A"/"B" when two motions stack). Unselected hover only brightens the hairline to ink-600 — hover never impersonates selection.

rules.name: The Empty-States-Teach Rule
rules.body: Every empty state teaches the first run: one icon in lime at 80% opacity, a one-line title, at most one short body, one action — centered in a hairlined ink-900 panel.

dos: Do build depth from the ink ladder (950 ground → 900 panel → 850 well → 800 raised) under 1px ink-700 hairlines that brighten to ink-600 on hover.
Do set every number and identifier — seconds, seeds, credits, job ids, statuses, commands — in Spline Sans Mono with tabular figures.
Do give each page exactly one entrance: animate-rise with rise-1…rise-5 staggers, and nothing else on load.
Do mark selection with the lime ring + mono tag, activity with the recording-lamp pulse, and a disabled primary as explicitly off (ink-800 fill, ink-400 text).
Do ship a same-name .json provenance sidecar (prompt + createdAt) beside every generated raster and clip in public/media/, and caption generated media honestly on the page.
Do put text over footage on a from-ink-950/95 gradient scrim, and honor prefers-reduced-motion (stills instead of loops; the global animation kill stays).
donts: Don't add a light theme — the build commits to a single dark look (color-scheme: dark) and defines no light palette.
Don't use lime decoratively in the studio; it means state (selection, active, primary action, focus). Page-scale lime exists only on the landing's closing block.
Don't arrange stat cards, hero metrics, or dashboard tiles — the world's founding refusal.
Don't cast drop shadows for separation; the only shadows are the lime CTA glow, the landing console drop, and the playhead-thumb shadow.
Don't introduce radii beyond 6 / 8 / 12px / full, a second accent hue, or a third typeface.
